mapper.delete: DELETE FROM forum_favorite WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND thread_id=#{threadId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS id,t.kind,t.board_key AS board,t.title,t.content,t.excerpt,t.tags,CAST(t.author_account_id AS CHAR) AS authorAccountId, t.author_name AS authorName,t.reward,CAST(t.cover_attachment_id AS CHAR) AS coverAttachmentId,t.replies_count AS replies, t.views_count AS views,t.likes_count AS likes,t.pinned,t.solved, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt,f.created_at AS favoritedAt FROM forum_favorite f JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=f.thread_id AND t.deleted=0 WHERE f.account_id=#{accountId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forum_favorite f JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=f.thread_id AND t.deleted=0 WHERE f.account_id=#{accountId}
